usedFor: LinkedIn is where your company page gets seen and HubSpot is where follow-up is tracked. “When a new comment is added to a post on a company page” can run “Create Deal”, so engagement turns into a lead.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new comment is added to a post on a company page” in LinkedIn, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A comment is a real person reacting and it is pushed as it happens, so the deal starts while the conversation is live. The post trigger only records your own publishing.

watchOut: “When a new post is published on a company page” is polling and runs on a schedule. “Update Deal” needs the ID of an existing deal.
